Very friendly and nice atmosphere, good Bún Chả!
Aug 2026 • Couples
We were at this restaurant and our experience was overall very positive!
The staff proved to be extremely friendly, welcoming, and kind right from the start, making the service pleasant and attentive. The place is really cute and well-kept.
For dinner I ordered the classic Bún Chả: a definitely good and tasty dish, although, having tried several around Hanoi during the trip, I must say that it was not the absolute best one tasted in the city. However, a valid, fresh, and pleasant preparation.
Overall it is an excellent choice for a pleasant dinner in the center of Hanoi, supported by fantastic hospitality. Recommended!

A side of people watching with your meal
Mar 2026 • Couples
Beer Street is primarily a drinking scene, and the menus reflected that — so I looked up nearby dinner options and landed on Vietnamese Lantern Restaurant. Good call.

We grabbed a table on the upstairs balcony — not the most comfortable seating, but perfect for watching the street below. As it turned out, the street found us equally interesting: multiple passersby stopped to photograph us from below, and we laughed and posed obligingly. An unexpectedly fun dynamic.

We both ordered a glass of the local Dalat wine, which was decent. My partner's seafood dish arrived without issue. Mine, taken by a newer server who had written it down but apparently never submitted it, simply never came. When I mentioned it, the manager apologized immediately and had it out within minutes — chopped chilies and all. Quite good.

A small hiccup, handled well. If you're in the Beer Street area and want a proper sit-down meal, Vietnamese Lantern is worth your time — especially for the balcony seats, if you don't mind a little audience.
